requirements.description: Arbitrary pairwise distinct real nodes in [-1,1] and the original cardinal-product ordinary integral
requirements.evidence: Challenge.lean defines the cardinal product and ordinary integral directly; admissible_eq, integral_eq, and infimum_eq prove correspondence.

requirements.description: An explicit exact value of the minimum for every positive integer n
requirements.evidence: RootSelection.lean defines the algebraic value rule; algebraicMinimum_eq_minimum and erdos1131_solution hold for every n > 0, including n = 1.

requirements.description: The exact minimum is attained by admissible nodes
requirements.evidence: MinimumAttainment.lean proves minimum_attained for every positive node count; CompleteSolution.lean provides the attained value and universal lower bound.

requirements.description: The rational polynomial and matrix construction has the stated finite degree bound
requirements.evidence: CoefficientDegrees.lean proves boundaryPolynomial_degree; BoundaryPolynomial.lean proves nonvanishing; RootSelection.lean selects the root by signatures at rational samples.

requirements.description: The exact-value and prior asymptotic proofs use the same infimum
requirements.evidence: Submission.lean proves energy_eq_reference_functional, attainable_values_eq_reference, and minimum_eq_reference, including the bijective node representation.

requirements.description: The proposed asymptotic n(2-m_n) -> 1 is false for the original sequence
requirements.evidence: Submission.lean transfers the prior shifted asymptotic disproof; Challenge.lean proves asymptotic_original and full_original_problem for the original infimum.
